summary: A link field points at a table that does not exist, so its cells link to nothing.
A lookup or rollup field reads through a link field, or from a field, that does not exist, so it shows nothing.
A dashboard reads a table that does not exist, so its widgets show nothing.
A formula fails to evaluate on a record and shows an error instead of a value.
A formula names a field its table does not have, which it reads as empty.
A cell holds a value its field's type cannot show, such as text in a number field.
A select cell holds a value that is not one of its field's options.
A record leaves a required field empty.
Two records of a table have the same primary value, so links and lookups cannot tell them apart.
